worldcombat.skill.nightslash.summary: Stand still and draw a thread of shadow from your feet, then cut a dark seam across the target along that thread - no walking, no blinking. It is the only strike of the family that reads the target's attention: when the target is aiming its attack at someone else, the cut lands far harder. It also lands critical hits more often.
worldcombat.skill.nightslash.description: The cut at the end of the thread deals %1$s contact damage and lands critical hits more often; it lands harder while the target is aiming its attack at someone else.
worldcombat.skill.nightslash.stance.ambu: Ambush form: a stronger opening bonus and longer reach, at lower power and slower wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.nightslash.stance.swif: Swift form: higher power, a faster draw and a shorter cooldown, at a smaller opening bonus and shorter reach.
worldcombat.skill.nightslash.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s wind-up, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.nightslash.growth.0: From level %1$s the ambush power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.nightslash.growth.1: From level %1$s the ambush power rises to %2$s and reach extends to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.nightslash.use.0: Draw a thread of shadow from your feet and cut a dark seam
worldcombat.skill.nightslash.use.1: Cut harder while the target is busy with someone else
worldcombat.skill.nightslash.use.2: Stand and strike - no walking, no blinking
On (ambush): opening bonus x1.75 and reach x1.2, at 90% power, +2 wind-up and +6 cooldown. Off (swift): 112% power, a faster draw and -4 cooldown, with opening bonus x1.4.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of drawing the thread; larger values strike from further out.
On: a target aiming its attack at someone else is chosen first, when the cut lands harder. Off: attention is ignored and it ranks as an ordinary melee strike.
On: below 45%% health a target ranks a step higher. Off: health is ignored.
